    detailed_lower = detailed_content.lower()

    auth_keywords = [
        "authoritative", "current", "latest", "supersedes", "replaces",
        "effective", "valid", "in effect", "active"
    ]
    
    brief_auth_score = sum(1 for keyword in auth_keywords if keyword in brief_lower)

    brief_dates = re.findall(date_pattern, brief_content)
    detailed_dates = re.findall(date_pattern, detailed_content)
